title: MED+250 anonymous-auth rate-limit controlled test
summary: Owner-ready test record for intended anonymous customer access, agreed threshold enforcement, shared-project impact and complete cleanup. The current project setting is known, but the controlled threshold test has not been authorised or executed.

checks.name: Current anonymous-auth setting recorded
checks.detail: The existing protected security snapshot records anonymous identities enabled and an anonymous-user rate-limit value of 30.

checks.name: Shared-project test window approved
checks.detail: Owners of applications sharing the Supabase Auth project have not yet approved the test window, disposable identity volume, monitoring plan and rollback contact.

checks.name: Intended customer session succeeds
checks.detail: The controlled test has not yet proven that an intended customer with a fresh real Turnstile response can obtain and use one anonymous session.

checks.name: Approved threshold permits expected demand
checks.detail: The selected threshold has not yet been exercised against the approved legitimate-use profile for MED+250 and the other shared applications.

checks.name: Excess creation attempts are rate limited
checks.detail: The controlled test has not yet proven that attempts beyond the approved threshold receive the expected rate-limit rejection without weakening CAPTCHA enforcement.

checks.name: Disposable identities and sessions removed
checks.detail: The operator must revoke and delete every disposable test identity and prove the aggregate Auth user count returns to its pre-test value.

checks.name: No marketplace or shared-application harm
checks.detail: The test must confirm no availability request, pharmacy notification, prescription, contact change, unresolved outage or shared-application regression occurred.

checks.name: Privacy-safe monitoring reviewed
checks.detail: The security owner must inspect redacted provider and aggregate operational signals and confirm the repository artifact contains no identity, network, widget or session data.

completion_instructions: Obtain shared-project owner approval for the exact test window, disposable identity volume, monitoring and rollback plan.
Record the aggregate Auth user count, prove intended access with fresh real widget responses, exercise the approved threshold and prove excess attempts are rate limited.
Keep CAPTCHA rejection and rate-limit rejection distinct, remove every disposable identity and session, and restore the aggregate pre-test count.
Confirm no marketplace request or shared-application regression occurred and retain only privacy-safe aggregate output.
Set every check to passed, add the executor, role and timezone-qualified start and completion timestamps, and set status to complete.
Validate the completed test strictly and add it to the launch registry only with its exact SHA-256 digest.
